docstring:
The set of integers which are the sum of at most two $2$-powerful numbers has density $0$.

Erdős called this 'easy'. Baker and Brüdern [BaBr94] gave the first proof in the literature.
references: [BaBr94] Baker, R. C. and Brüdern, J., _On sums of two squarefull numbers_. Math. Proc. Cambridge Philos. Soc. (1994), 1-5.
[He88](https://oeis.org/A187054) Heath-Brown, D. R., _Ternary quadratic forms and sums of three square-full numbers_. (1988), 137-163.
type_pretty: {n | ∃ S, S.card ≤ 2 ∧ (∀ s ∈ S, Nat.Full 2 s) ∧ n = S.sum}.HasDensity 0
